notes: The coordinate in plans-v1.json (23.6304 N, 70.8407 E, the Wikipedia and Wikidata value) and the OpenStreetMap 'Surkotada' polygon around 23.626 N, 70.840 E show farmland and scrub with no excavated structures in any release. The coordinate in the repository's site census (experiments/2026-10-08-site-map-and-overview/data/sites-census.json, from GAZETTEER2018, 23.6113 N, 70.9173 E), about 7.9 km to the east-south-east, lies on an excavated stone citadel inside a fenced protected area. Its wall layout matches the fold-out plan: house 3, the gateway complex, the platform and the western rampart line up, and the fitted scale agrees with the scale bar to within 1 per cent. Points were read on Wayback release 8432 (in service 2021-07-21 to 2021-09-28; capture date not reported by the tool), the clearest of eight releases examined (current Vantor Vivid 2026-03-26 and Wayback 16749, 47471, 64776, 32553, 52304, 26334); later releases show the same walls with more vegetation. All twelve points lie on exposed ancient masonry, so the fit without exposed masonry has no points; the plan draws no modern feature. Plan pixels were read from the render surkotada_p0061_300dpi.png on wall centrelines. The memoir's contour plan (PDF page index 34) was viewed for context only. No statement of a wall's or a town's orientation was seen while working on this plan.
